contribution.concept: AIPSeLEX: a novel idioms/proverbs sentiment lexicon for modern standard Arabic and colloquial

evidence.evidence: Consequently, In order to facilitate the task of detection and classification of lexical phrases for automated SA systems, this paper presents AIPSeLEX a novel idioms/ proverbs sentiment lexicon for modern standard Arabic (MSA) and colloquial.

contribution.concept: experiments evaluating coverage and accuracy of AIPSeLEX

evidence.evidence: Finally, several experiments were carried out on various data, including Arabic tweets and Arabic microblogs (hotel reservation, product reviews, and TV program comments) from publicly available Arabic online reviews websites (social media, blogs, forums, e-commerce web sites) to evaluate the coverage and accuracy of AIPSeLEX.
